scope: A prospective synopsis of all Md2 14r prose. Md2 13v remains diagram context and counterevidence. Not a diplomatic reproduction or target image identification.
target_scope: All473 already-owned GDT1042 native rows:156ZL,157IT,160RF, all24 loci. No target word values occur in this roster.

duties.content: The prose concerns twelve winds in the preceding figure; four are first/principal winds.
duties.qualification: Principal is a rendering of first/crowned status, not generated ancestry.

duties.content: The first is called Oster/east and comes from the east.
The east entry states hot and dry.
One companion stands on each side; the prose explicitly points to the figure.
A plural wind referent is healthy/good and does not alter the body, with a following uncertain qualification.
duties.alternatives: Companions, east with companions, or a broader previously mentioned wind group; no universal inheritance to each companion is assumed.
duties.gap: The following qualification's precise wording is not securely transcribed and must remain a source gap rather than be dropped as satisfied.

duties.content: The second is called Auster/south and also has two companions.
It is warm and moist.
It passes through desert, warm/moist lands and much sea.
It harms human nature/body, causes sleepiness, headache and dizziness, especially harms sick people and alters the body.
The continued sentence at the right-column top says it does no good and causes decay/rotting.
duties.qualification: Exact final bodily phrasing is uncertain. Preserve that source uncertainty; do not import west's explicit causal connector into south.

duties.content: The third is called west/wester, from where the sun sets.
It also has two companions.
The same wind is cold and moist by its nature.
That wind is always warm here/among us.
duties.qualification: The local place and generality both remain explicit; this is not one measured arrival episode.

duties.content: It traverses warm land.
duties.qualification: Land and wind are different typed holders. Shared warm predication must not silently identify the holders.

duties.content: The warm-land traversal explicitly explains W04's local warmth.
duties.qualification: The explanatory result is exactly the local-warmth proposition, not natural cold/moist, the entire paragraph or medical benefit.

duties.content: The same wind does not harm us.
duties.qualification: Separate assertion; no warmth-implies-benefit inference and no forced causal link from traversal to harmlessness.

duties.content: The fourth is Boreas/from north land and also has two companions.
Cold and dry are stated with unresolved property owner.
duties.qualification: Do not silently force the wind owner.

duties.content: The subsequent one traverses cold land and mountains.
alternatives: One companion of the north wind
duties.qualification: Keep this owner question separate from N02.

duties.content: That N03 subject does much good and much harm, strengthens human powers, brings cough/a flux-like condition, harms old people and constricts the chest.
duties.qualification: Mixed effects remain; exact flux term uncertain. Do not label every northern principal or companion uniformly beneficial.

duties.content: Knowing/recognizing winds is useful and enables appropriate self-direction and healing.
duties.qualification: A general capability/advice conclusion, not a concrete treatment, actual recovery, dosage or universal quality-to-remedy algorithm.

source_uncertainty_policy: A future rendering must retain alternative owner analyses or mark the affected source duty unresolved. Writing disjunction into the target is an additional semantic assumption, not a transcription of the source. Alternative packages must be counted; choosing whichever attachment fits later is forbidden.

The top corrected orient association with moistness/rain/growth conflicts or stands in unresolved tension with east hot/dry in14r.
No rotation, repaired name list, descendant-generation claim or four/twelve-part target map is licensed.
prospective_exclusions: Exact curved diagram names and unresolved inscription letterforms
Diplomatic spelling reproduction of the two complete faces
not_entailed: Every companion inherits its principal's predicates
first_contract_minimum: The entire W01-W07 argument, with actual warm predication of land and wind, written introductions/references and separately scoped causal result/no-harm. All remaining duties remain owed by the whole pass.
